title: Pulsar APX eRig Glass Mouthpiece
description:
This mouthpiece is an official replacement part for the Pulsar APX eRig. Made from quality borosilicate glass, this mouthpiece is extra thick for durability and has a wide-rimmed design to ensure users get a good seal when inhaling.

Details:
Replacement mouthpiece
Borosilicate glass
Wide-rimmed design
Official replacement part for the Pulsar APX eRig
